blockers.claim: The candidate does not provide the explicit positive design scope required for a condition-1 disposition and drops material preview boundaries imposed by its adopted D-055 selection authority.
blockers.evidence: File 08 condition 1 requires an explicit, scoped, reviewed pre-blueprint disposition that names what may be designed without pretending blocked semantics are settled. The candidate's sole whatMayBeDesigned entry names the entire 'Architecture preview that does not pretend residuals are closed'; its bound permits preview docs to name residuals as open and forbids treating three kinds of evidence as residual closure. That is a circular anti-closure rule, not a bounded design surface. More importantly, adopted D-055's frozen subject states the named preview consequence: Facts/Coverage design stays blocked where R01 says so; identity-dependent residuals ride DR-006; EVIDENCE, retention, D9, R-1, and G19 residuals ride their owning rows; R12 stays unrepaired; and R16 stays Route C. The candidate preserves R16 and lists abbreviated unresolved topics, but it does not state the R01 design block, the DR-006 ride, or the named owning-row rides. A list of matters that must not be called settled is weaker than saying which design is blocked, which existing disposition owns any permitted design, and which positive surfaces may proceed. Because condition1EffectIfOwnerRecorded says this artifact may discharge condition 1, an owner record could otherwise turn the blanket 'architecture preview' phrase into permission to design residual-dependent semantics so long as they are labeled open. That exceeds D-055 and fails the register's literal scope test.
blockers.impact: The candidate is not safe to owner-record as the DR-011 condition-1 disposition. It can mechanically discharge the remaining condition-1 row without a determinate preview boundary and can bypass the exact cross-row routing D-055 adopted, even while truthfully leaving every residual non-CLOSED.
blockers.proposedFix: Replace P-011-1 with an explicit positive scope. State that DR-011 adds no independent semantic permission beyond the exact surfaces already allowed by the owner-recorded DR-002 through DR-010 preview dispositions and D-002/D-018, pin those effective dispositions or otherwise identify their operative bounds, and enumerate any additional DR-011-specific surface if one exists. Carry D-055's named consequence explicitly: R01 Facts/Coverage design remains blocked; identity-dependent work rides DR-006; EVIDENCE/retention/D9/R-1/G19 work rides the named owning rows; R12 remains unrepaired; R16 remains Route C. Make clear that residual-dependent recipes, schemas, identities, exits, custody, proof, checker standing, and product boundaries gain no design permission from the parent disposition. Re-freeze and re-dispatch corrected bytes.
